sign_conventions.home_margin: home_score - away_score; positive means home team won
sign_conventions.nflverse_spread_line: source-native nflverse convention: positive means the home team is favored by that many points; negative means the away team is favored
sign_conventions.home_spread: normalized sportsbook handicap from home-team perspective; negative means home favorite
sign_conventions.sly_home_spread: Sly handicap normalized to home-team perspective; negative means home favorite

prediction_snapshots.name: FRIDAY_FREEZE
prediction_snapshots.description: First full-slate decision state after Sly issues Friday lines. Only data published at or before snapshot_timestamp is allowed.

prediction_snapshots.name: PRE_KICK_FINAL
prediction_snapshots.description: Final decision state immediately before each game's betting lock/kickoff. Only data published at or before snapshot_timestamp is allowed.

point_in_time_rules: Every source timestamp used in a feature must be <= snapshot_timestamp.
Rolling football features must use only games completed before snapshot_timestamp.
Target-game final score and post-kickoff data are prohibited from all features.
Closing lines may be used only for a snapshot if the closing timestamp is <= snapshot_timestamp.
A Friday row may not use Sunday market, injury, depth-chart, weather or external-source updates.
Missing external predictions remain missing; do not impute as 50 percent or neutral.
External recommendations at a different spread must retain their native reference spread.
If a historical source cannot be reconstructed point-in-time, exclude it from training and use prospective evaluation instead.
